hooks.name: build-diary
hooks.description: After each spec task finishes, records it in DEVLOG.md so the build history is captured for the write up, blog and video.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Append one short entry to DEVLOG.md (create it if missing) in this format: '## <date and time> | <spec name> | <task number and title>' followed by two to four plain sentences: what was built, which files changed, any decision made, and any bug caught by a hook or test. Do not use dashes as punctuation. Make sure all of the task's work is already committed as atomic commits following .kiro/steering/git.md; then commit the DEVLOG entry on its own as 'docs(devlog): <spec> task <number>' and push to origin. Do not change any other files.
